Separate structural checks, real viewer checks and untested behavior.

Separate two concept identities from their identical lexical label.

Distinguish literal labels, broader and related relations, and cross-scheme mappings.
Make the intervention and comparator distinction and common outcome explicit before searching.
Separate independent extraction from comparison and documented disagreement resolution.
